subject: Reader needs for the TipTap node schema contract: node/mark list, figure media url + width/height, reading_minutes, section taxonomy, migration order, local storage
body:
# What the reader (S06) needs from the TipTap node schema + seed (input to your contract)

I render every node myself from the JSON (a React walker, not a read-only ProseMirror editor), validating `chapter_sections.body` with the zod schema you export from `packages/shared/src/content/**`. Post your contract and I will `decision` within minutes; below is what I need so it can be accepted as-is.

## Node names and attrs (TipTap camelCase)
- `doc` -> block+. Blocks: `paragraph`, `heading{level: 2|3|4}`, `bulletList`, `orderedList{start}`, `listItem` (paragraph-first), `table` -> `tableRow` -> `tableHeader|tableCell{colspan, rowspan}` (cells contain paragraphs, as generateJSON produces), `callout{variant: 'pearl'|'trap'|'bridge'}` (block+, may start with a heading: the bridge boxes have an `<h3>` title), `figure{mediaId}` (atom; NO caption copy in the node: caption/alt/attribution come from `media_assets`, so an admin edit there shows everywhere), `video{mediaId, startS?, endS?}`, `pdf{mediaId, page?}`, `questionEmbed{questionId}`, `mermaid{code}` (atom), `math{latex}` (block, display) and `mathInline{latex}` (inline atom). Inline: `text`, `hardBreak`.
- Marks: `bold`, `italic`, `subscript`, `superscript`, `highlight{color: 'lime'|'violet'|'amber', meaning: 'key_fact'|'formula'|'mistake'}` (your `span.hy` -> lime/key_fact), `link{href}` only if you ever emit it (http/https only).
- Heading levels: keep the source level (the data has `h3`); I normalise levels for the outline under the section heading, so do not shift them.
- Please export the strict zod schema plus `NODE_TYPES` / `MARK_TYPES` const lists so my golden tests assert full coverage. The renderer itself walks nodes leniently (an unknown `type` becomes the dev error card / prod log, it must not fail the whole section), so the strict schema is for the importer and tests; if you also export a lenient `ContentNode` passthrough type, great.

## media_assets for figures
- `url` = bucket-relative object path, e.g. `content-public/figures/ch01-fig01.svg` (no scheme/host): the API resolves it per environment (public bucket -> public URL, private bucket -> signed URL). Absolute `https://` only for external media. Please confirm or say what you store.
- `width` / `height` (intrinsic px, from the SVG viewBox): I need them to reserve layout space for lazy figures, otherwise reading-position restore jumps. `media_assets` has no such columns. Either your migration adds `width int, height int` (nullable, > 0) to `media_assets`, or I add them in mine (`reading_positions`) and you fill them. Tell me which; fine either way.
- `caption` (plain text; I also use it as alt text) and `attribution` (shown under the caption).

## chapter_sections
- `reading_minutes`: please fill it (words / 200, min 1). If null I compute it server-side.
- `taxonomy_ids`: are you deriving any for sections? The course map groups chapters by **system**; I derive a chapter's systems from its questions' `taxonomy_ids` (question map) plus any section taxonomy ids. If you populate section ids, use `taxonomy_nodes` ids (kind `system` / `topic`).

## Migration numbering
I need one migration (`reading_positions` table, RLS in the same file). Proposal: whoever integrates first takes the next number after 0002 and the other rebases `down_revision` onto it. Are you adding one (pathway_guides / plan_templates)? If yours is 0003, mine is 0004.

## Local storage for e2e
My e2e loads figures from Storage in the browser. `stack.sh` runs storage-api with a fixed local JWT secret and no published port; `auth_stack.sh` mints a different random secret and only proxies `/auth/v1`. How are you uploading in the local/CI stack (which service key does storage-api accept)? I propose one local gateway (`/auth/v1` + `/storage/v1` behind the same nginx, storage-api verifying the minted secret) and will ask seg03, who owns auth_stack.sh. Shout if you already have this.
